description: CPI-U all items, U.S. city average, not seasonally adjusted, 1982-84=100, monthly
publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
method: data/belvidere_il/reference/cpi_u_monthly.csv (fetch_reference.py); fiscal-year value = mean of the 12 months May-April; the base is the FY2026 mean; FY2026 has 11 months because the source has no October 2025 value, flagged missing_month; a year not yet over is provisional

description: Annual estimate of the resident population of the City of Belvidere, July 1, 2010-2019 (vintage 2019) and 2020-2025 (vintage 2025)
publisher: U.S. Census Bureau Population Estimates Program
terms: public data; cite U.S. Census Bureau
method: data/belvidere_il/reference/population_estimates.csv (fetch_reference.py); fiscal year N uses the July 1 estimate of year N-1, which falls inside the fiscal year (May 1 N-1 to April 30 N); the next July estimate is carried forward when it is not yet published; the vintages are not spliced

description: Equalized assessed valuation (EAV) of the City of Belvidere by tax levy year; tax levy year L is collected in fiscal year L+2
publisher: City of Belvidere annual audits (Assessed Valuations Tax Rates and Tax Extensions; Property Tax Levies and Collections)
method: data/belvidere_il/extracted/audits/FY20XX_audit_eav.csv (extract_audit_eav.py: text layer FY2016+, OCR of the page image for FY2015); the audits' five-to-ten-year windows overlap and must agree (build_reference.py), except where reference_overrides.csv decides
